lines: Jo na mil sake wohi bewafa, yeh badi ajeeb si baat hai
couplets.en: How strange to call the one beyond reach unfaithful.

lines: Jo chala gaya mujhe chhod kar, wohi aaj tak mere saath hai
couplets.en: The one who left me is with me still.

lines: Jo kisi nazar se ata hui, wohi roshni hai khayal mein
couplets.en: The light a glance bestowed still lingers in my thoughts.

lines: Woh na aa sake, rahoon muntazir, yeh khalish kahan thi visaal mein
couplets.en: They could not come and I wait on, but where was this ache when we were together?

lines: Meri justuju ko khabar nahin, na woh din rahe na woh raat hai
couplets.en: My longing has yet to learn that those days and nights are gone.

lines: Jo chala gaya mujhe chhod kar, wohi aaj tak mere saath hai
couplets.en: The one who left me is with me still.

lines: Jo na mil sake wohi bewafa
couplets.en: The one beyond reach is called unfaithful.

lines: Kare pyaar, lab pe gila na ho, yeh kisi kisi ka naseeb hai
couplets.en: Few are given to love without a word of complaint.

lines: Yeh karam hai uska, jafa nahin, woh juda bhi reh ke qareeb hai
couplets.en: It is a kindness that even in parting they remain close.

lines: Wohi aankh hai mere rubaru, usi haath mein mera haath hai
couplets.en: That same gaze meets mine, and my hand is still in theirs.

lines: Jo chala gaya mujhe chhod kar, wohi aaj tak mere saath hai
couplets.en: The one who left me is with me still.

lines: Jo na mil sake wohi bewafa
couplets.en: The one beyond reach is called unfaithful.

lines: Mera naam tak jo na le saka, jo mujhe qaraar na de saka
couplets.en: They could not so much as say my name or give me peace.

lines: Mera naam tak jo na le saka, jo mujhe qaraar na de saka
couplets.en: They could not so much as say my name or give me peace.

lines: Jise ikhtiyaar to tha magar, mujhe apna pyaar na de saka
couplets.en: Their love was theirs to give, yet they could never give it to me.

lines: Wohi shakhs meri talaash hai, wohi dard meri hayaat hai
couplets.en: It is still that person I seek, still that ache I live by.
